newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Mediterranee plans new EuroCD soon.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Mediterranee plans new EuroCD soon.

text.p: Lebanon's Banque Mediterranee will shortly follow up its successful $100 million EuroCD issue with a second tranche under the $300 million programme it launched last month, chairman Mustafa Razian said on Friday.
The second tranche will be a three-year issue and will be launched in a month or so, Razian told Reuters in an interview.
The first tranche of the programme was a two-year issue on September 23. It was so heavily subscribed that it was increased to $100 million from a planned $50 million.
Razian declined to give the size of the planned second tranche.
"The programme was originally $150 million but we have raised it to $300 million," he said.
"The next step will be a three-year issue and the last tranche will be four or five years.
"We are still working on the programme. It should happen very shortly. In a month or so we will be arranging another tranche for three years," Razian added.
Asked how much the new tranche would be, he declined to give a figure and said "We feel out the market first and then respond to demand."
